tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Identify the group that holds an outsider perspective on the place where they live.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark multiple choice recalling insider and outsider perspectives.

units.summary: Identify the pair of examples showing impacts of external forces on a place.
Suggest why place is important in human experience.
units.difficulty_basis: 3-mark recall of the importance of place with developed points.

units.summary: Analyse data on ethnic groups in rural and urban England shown in two figures.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark level-marked analysis of two related quantitative figures, no wider knowledge required.

units.summary: Discuss how far attempts by external agencies to influence place-meanings create media places.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extended evaluation of a claim linking agencies and media places.

units.summary: Evaluate how far past and present development shape the social and economic character of a studied distant place.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark extended evaluation using own distant place study and two time frames.

units.summary: Outline one ethical issue to consider when collecting interview data.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark recall of ethics in qualitative data collection.

units.summary: Suggest how one type of map could help prepare for an investigation in a described place.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark application of a map type to planning using a short interview transcript.

units.summary: Suggest an investigation aim and outline one primary data collection method for a described place.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark application designing an aim and method from a transcript stimulus.

units.summary: Evaluate how useful secondary data sources were in meeting the aim of own enquiry.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark evaluation of own fieldwork data requiring a judgement.

units.summary: Assess how useful the data presentation methods used in own investigation were for analysis.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark assessment of own presentation techniques linked to analysis.

units.summary: Calculate the median owner-occupied housing value for one town.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark simple statistical calculation from supplied data.

units.summary: Plot two missing values on a dispersion diagram.
Complete a table and calculate a standard deviation to two decimal places.
Evaluate how useful the calculated statistics were for analysing housing data in the investigation.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark synthesis of several figures including dispersion diagram and standard deviation.

units.summary: Calculate the median peat depth for one area.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark simple statistical calculation from supplied data.

units.summary: Plot two missing values on a dispersion diagram.
Complete a table and calculate a standard deviation to two decimal places.
Evaluate how useful the calculated statistics were for analysing peat depth data in the investigation.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark synthesis of several figures including dispersion diagram and standard deviation.
